nodes.label: Rabattement Fold (Flatten-to-2D)
nodes.rationale: The step-4 fold is a dual-camera event: swoopToAnswerSheet flies an OrthographicCamera square-on while projectionMorphK blends perspective to orthographic over the 1600 ms easeFold hinge, so the folded corner reads as a true flat first-angle drawing; restorePerspective glides back to the 3D orbit.

nodes.label: Orbital Quadrant Flights
nodes.rationale: flyCamera sweeps a TRUE spherical orbit (quaternion slerp of the offset direction + radius/pivot lerp) and each Q1-Q4 pose sits physically inside its own room, so an east-west walk genuinely crosses behind the VP wall instead of cutting a straight chord through the corner.

nodes.label: HP/VP Plane Pair
nodes.rationale: hvPlanes.js draws the teal HP / amber VP pair with faint fills and a dense 'cage' grid; the beyond-fold extension is always built and faded independently via setExtendedOpacity so the shared Quadrant-I corner never re-fades or double-draws, and the HP sits in a pivot hinged on the X fold line. VP sheet border is solid amber by explicit override of the Two-Cue dash pairing.

nodes.label: Point Projector Rig
nodes.rationale: point.js draws P (ink sphere + paper halo) and its thick-dot top/front views p and p', with dashed fat-line projectors starting SPHERE_GAP off P so the dash begins cleanly at the sphere surface (Linux GL dash-shader fix); the on-VP p'-to-fold-line connector stays solid while the 3D VP projector stays dashed.

nodes.label: Frustum Illustration
nodes.rationale: frustums.js draws the step-5 classic textbook figure: cone frustums in Quadrants I and III (Q3 the point-reflection) with concentric-circle top views on HP and trapezoid front views on VP; the Q3 body carries renderOrder -3 so it draws beneath the translucent sheet grids for the 'cage' read and the transparent-to-opaque flip stays seamless.

nodes.label: Spatial Quadrant Label Layer
nodes.rationale: labelLayer.js owns the CSS2D HP/VP/XY callouts, boxed P/p/p' chips and I-IV quadrant numerals; a per-frame updateOcclusion raycasts camera to numeral against the sheet FILL meshes (Line2 grids excluded) and hides occluded numerals, running after renderer.render and before the CSS2D re-projection.

nodes.label: Transition Cross-Fades
nodes.rationale: A per-leaf fadeState opacity multiplier (re-stamped after every rebuild so a mid-fade rebuild never snaps) plus an always-disposed fade-out graveyard let applyView fade planes up on grow and cross-fade the point rig against the frustums across the 4-5 boundary; steps 1-3 carry foldPose:'unfolded' so back-nav auto-reverses the fold.

nodes.label: Room & Shadow Stepper
nodes.rationale: A Module-2-pattern guided-step controller (stepper.js) rendering the 5-step 'Room & Shadow' sequence (Reference Planes to Standard) from pure-data spatialSteps.js, gating Next behind the step-4 fold and pushing each step's view flags to the orchestrator via applyView.

nodes.label: Quiet Chrome Scrollbar (Spatial)
nodes.rationale: The #step-card scrollbar pill was retinted from --color-accent to --color-border per ADR-032 Quiet Chrome (WebKit thumb + Firefox scrollbar-color).
